target.statement: SPT (Tri, w/ sem) achieves 87.0% exact-match accuracy on the reverse-direction QA subset (A2Q), vs 3.0% for the standard model

compute.basis: Requires fine-tuning LLaMA-7B for 20 epochs plus running Vicuna-13B segmentation over the training data; both are multi-GPU jobs (paper uses 8x AMD MI200), far beyond an 8-core/16GB CPU laptop.

blockers: No code release (only a link to the unrelated Stanford Alpaca repo)
Requires fine-tuning LLaMA-7B (13B assistant Vicuna-13B) - not feasible on CPU
QA dataset from Berglund et al. 2023 not clearly downloadable
Segmentation pipeline depends on Vicuna-13b-v1.3 inference
title: Mitigating Reversal Curse in Large Language Models via Semantic-aware Permutation Training
